answer: A sonnet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the atlas of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, unlocked only after continuous uptime, rewards vest against future work. Reaching the juniper of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
